claims.text: Let \(v=v_{r,s,t,n}\) be bigrassmannian, \(1\le t\le r,s\le n\), \(t>r+s-n\), and put \(q=n-r\), \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(q-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\). Let \(\Lambda=\mathbb Z[h_1,h_2,\ldots]\) be the integral symmetric-function ring with Schur basis \(\{s_\lambda\}\), \(I_{r,q}=\bigoplus_{\lambda\nsubseteq q^r}\mathbb Zs_\lambda\), \(A=\Lambda/I_{r,q}\), \(A_+=\bigoplus_{d>0}A_d\), and \(J_v=\bigoplus_{i^j\subseteq\lambda\subseteq q^r}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda\subseteq A\). Then both \(G_L=\{\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}:\rho\subseteq b^a\}\) and \(G_R=\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}\) map to homogeneous integral bases of \(Q=J_v/A_+J_v\), hence both minimally generate \(J_v\). Consequently \(Q\cong\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Ze_\rho\), \(\deg e_\rho=ij+|\rho|\), \(H_Q(z)=z^{ij}\binom{a+b}{a}_z\), and \(Q\) is torsion-free. The pairing \(\langle e_\rho,e_\sigma\rangle=\delta_{\sigma,\rho^\vee}\), \(\rho^\vee=(b-\rho_a,\ldots,b-\rho_1)\), is perfect from \(Q_d\) to \(Q_{2ij+ab-d}\). For \(a=0\), \(b^0\) has the unique empty partition, declared self-complementary. The cited source supplies the lower-family theorem and generation statement , and its no-syzygy mechanism is .
